method.engine: m_engine.php (adapted from pt19x-merge/recheck.php): lrgPromptLookup + lrgDlgDecorateEntries on the fixture's own list; the want=1 fast path lrgDlgAnswerWant on HIS words (emit log parsed for do=pick AND do=show); her T-key on the target (lrgDlgDecideEntry); LEAVE on every list (lrgDlgDecide, "never mind" and "goodbye"). clicks_ok 1, drv 1 (scene beats measured as driven).
method.inputs: lrg_questline_extended.json (2,005 fixture beats + 107 quarantine beats; 2,064 with a list), brotherhood.verified.json (260 beats with a list; texts from the index by info_key), generated probes per beat (deferral / not-yet / hedge / refusal / 3 echoes), gap probes (G4 work, G6 follower verbs, G13 price questions, G16 hand-overs) and the COVERAGE evidence sentences
method.recheck: pt19x-merge recheck.php (only the index path made an env var) + evaluate.py, unchanged, over recheck_in.json (212 danger rows, 826 generic commit beats)
method.canonical: tools/test_questline.php (a copy with a per-line recorder) over tools/fixtures/lrg_questline_adversarial.json and the spec fixture; plus a 14-beat cross-check of the engine's never-clicks
method.outcome_classes: fast = the fast path clicks the target on his words; tkey = nothing on the fast path, her T-key on the target picks it (the model decides); ask = a park, she asks once and "yes" clicks; nothing; wrong = the fast path clicks another line; show = the fast path hands the menu back (lethal)
method.protected: commit, class commit / check / pay, scripted (incl. Invisible Continue), goodbye, crit >= 1, cost > 0, a check kind
